newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Airways picks offer to fund Boeings.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Airways picks offer to fund Boeings.

text.p: The national flag carrier Kuwait Airways Corp will announce later on Wednesday the awarding of a $280 million financing deal for the purchase of two new Boeing Co 777-200s, a senior official said.
"A decision has been taken and an announcement will be made today," he said.
The carrier is seeking a $280 million financing deal for the two aircraft which were ordered in July for delivery in 1998. It has an option on a third 777 twinjet.
The tender closed in early November and the airline has been reviewing the offers since. It is sought by several domestic, regional and international institutions including:

CitiBank and Chase of the United States, Japan's Sumitomo Bank, the Bahrain-based Gulf International Bank, a consortium of Kuwaiti banks under National Bank of Kuwait and Kuwait's The International Investor Co.
The new 777s will replace two Boeing 747s currently in service. The airline also operates 15 Airbus Industrie aircraft.
